email_body:
Dear CapsLock Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Creative Marketing Project Coordinator role. Your description of a fast-moving creative pipeline—hundreds of video ads, images and copy variations tested monthly—is exactly the kind of environment where I do my best work. I bring over two years of hands-on project coordination and operations experience, managing high volumes of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking. I use ClickUp daily to turn requests into clear, structured tasks, and I'm an avid user of AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to streamline workflows and automate repetitive work.

What draws me to CapsLock is the emphasis on process improvement and scaling without losing accuracy. I've built automated workflows and used AI to reduce manual effort, and I enjoy finding smarter ways to keep pipelines running smoothly. I'm detail-oriented, proactive in following up with cross-functional teams, and genuinely curious about creative marketing and ad content.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help your team keep the creative pipeline efficient and reliable.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear CapsLock Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Creative Marketing Project Coordinator position at CapsLock. Your description of a fast-moving creative pipeline—hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations tested monthly—resonates with me. I thrive on bringing order to busy environments, and I'm eager to contribute to a team that values innovation and collaboration.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage multiple projects with strict deadlines, using ClickUp to turn requests into clear, structured tasks. I coordinate with designers, content creators and clients to ensure everything is aligned and delivered on time. My technical background in SEO and web development has given me a sharp eye for detail, whether reviewing content for typos or spotting visual inconsistencies. I'm also a daily user of AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude, and I've built automations to streamline repetitive work—skills that align perfectly with your emphasis on process improvement.

What draws me to CapsLock is the opportunity to scale a creative pipeline while maintaining accuracy and quality. I enjoy finding smarter ways to work and am always looking for ways to improve task structures and handoff processes. I'm proactive in following up with cross-functional teams, and I'm genuinely curious about creative marketing and ad content. I'm confident that my experience in operations, project coordination and AI-driven automation will allow me to contribute quickly.

I'd love the chance to discuss how I can help your team keep the creative pipeline running smoothly and efficiently. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Over 2 years of experience in project coordination and operations, managing high volumes of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking.
• Daily hands-on use of ClickUp to turn requests into clear, structured tasks, assign them, and track progress from request to launch.
• Proactive cross-team communicator, following up with designers, content creators and clients to ensure deadlines are met and bottlenecks are resolved early.
• Sharp eye for detail from SEO and web development background, reviewing content for typos, formatting errors and visual inconsistencies.
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to streamline workflows and automate repetitive work, with a focus on process improvement.
